_doc: Dated changes to who holds a pin, replayed over atlas-pins.json up to a year by tools/build-borders.py (Paradox province-history shape: store the changes, derive the state; see docs/changes/map-timeline/layers-and-time-roadmap.md). One row per change: `pin` is a frozen pin id, `event` a frozen atlas-events id whose own text states the outcome, and the row sets `status` and/or `control` exactly as a pin would carry them. A row whose event does not state the outcome does not belong here.
